dialogue.raw: §fI'm looking for my §6Liege§f, but my §cEyes§f went rogue.
dialogue.text: I'm looking for my Liege, but my Eyes went rogue.
dialogue.zh: 我正在寻找我的主君，可我的眼睛却失控了。

dialogue.raw: §fIf you calm one of them down, I will be able to §ateleport§f you to it.
dialogue.text: If you calm one of them down, I will be able to teleport you to it.
dialogue.zh: 你若能安抚其中一只，我就能把你传送到它那里。

segments.text: If you calm one of them down, I will be able to
segments.zh: 你若能安抚其中一只，我就能把你

dialogue.context: Porhtal / After calming all the Eyes
dialogue.raw: §fBefore you venture into §dThe Rift §fagain, I must thank you.
dialogue.text: Before you venture into The Rift again, I must thank you.
dialogue.zh: 在你再次踏入裂隙之前，我必须向你道谢。

dialogue.context: Porhtal / After calming all the Eyes
dialogue.raw: §fYou have calmed all of my eyes.
dialogue.text: You have calmed all of my eyes.
dialogue.zh: 你安抚了我所有的眼睛。

dialogue.context: Porhtal / After calming all the Eyes
dialogue.text: I now comprehend my purpose here.
dialogue.zh: 如今，我终于明白自己在此的使命。

dialogue.context: Porhtal / After calming all the Eyes
dialogue.raw: §fI am but a creation, a link through time, a messenger, a catalyst.
dialogue.text: I am but a creation, a link through time, a messenger, a catalyst.
dialogue.zh: 我只是一件造物，一道贯穿时间的纽带，一个信使，一个引子。

dialogue.context: Porhtal / After calming all the Eyes
dialogue.raw: §fSoon, our destinies will intertwine once more.
dialogue.text: Soon, our destinies will intertwine once more.
dialogue.zh: 不久之后，我们的命运将再度交织。

dialogue.context: Porhtal / After calming all the Eyes
dialogue.raw: §fYou must repair the breach, for I am to receive and deliver a vision from it.
dialogue.text: You must repair the breach, for I am to receive and deliver a vision from it.
dialogue.zh: 你必须修复那道裂口，我要从中接收并传递一道幻象。
